name: merrec-agent-session
method: Statements written in order by an AI agent (Claude, in Claude Code) on 2026-10-12 against a freshly started MerRec scale server over Arrow Flight SQL, each written after reading the previous response, following the GPU UDTF discovery guide. On 2026-10-15 the same statements were replayed in the same order against a freshly started server built from commit d4b48c569, with both source Parquet files in the operating-system page cache; elapsed times, query ids, execution details and rows are from that replay. Result rows of steps 1, 3, 4 and 5 are identical to the 2026-10-12 session; step 2 returns the descriptor in its current shape. The probes were sent after the session to record the planning-time errors for two wrong column names.

steps.intent: Which graph functions can rank brands around a seed?
steps.sql:
SELECT function_name, summary
FROM gpu_list_functions()
WHERE provider = 'cugraph' AND (function_name LIKE '%pagerank%' OR function_name LIKE '%jaccard%')
ORDER BY function_name

rows.summary: Compare explicit vertex pairs by dividing the size of their shared-neighbor intersection by the size of their neighbor union.
Rank vertices by the stationary probability of a damped random walk that follows outgoing edges.
Rank vertices with PageRank while biasing random-walk restarts toward explicitly weighted personalization vertices.

steps.intent: Which vertex is Barbie? Look up the brand id to seed from
steps.sql:
SELECT brand_id, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM merrec_items
WHERE brand_name = 'Barbie'
GROUP BY brand_id
ORDER BY items DESC

steps.intent: Before spending GPU time: will the whole query run on the GPU?
steps.sql:
EXPLAIN GPU
WITH likes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT -(e.user_id + 1) AS src, CAST(i.brand_id AS BIGINT) AS dst,
         e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00' AS after_release
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'item_like' AND i.brand_id <> 0
    AND e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-01 00:00:00'
    AND e.event_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00'
), lift_before AS (
  SELECT p.vertex, p.value / r.value AS lift
  FROM cugraph_personalized_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE NOT after_release),
    personalization => (SELECT 2595 AS vertex, 1.0 AS value),
    directed => false) p
  JOIN cugraph_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE NOT after_release), directed => false) r
    ON r.vertex = p.vertex
), lift_after AS (
  SELECT p.vertex, p.value / r.value AS lift
  FROM cugraph_personalized_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE after_release),
    personalization => (SELECT 2595 AS vertex, 1.0 AS value),
    directed => false) p
  JOIN cugraph_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE after_release), directed => false) r
    ON r.vertex = p.vertex
), fans AS (
  SELECT dst AS brand_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN after_release THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS fans_before,
         SUM(CASE WHEN after_release THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fans_after
  FROM likes GROUP BY dst
), brands AS (
  SELECT CAST(brand_id AS BIGINT) AS brand_id, MIN(brand_name) AS brand_name
  FROM merrec_items WHERE brand_id <> 0 GROUP BY brand_id
)
SELECT b.brand_name, f.fans_before, f.fans_after,
       lb.lift AS lift_before, la.lift AS lift_after, la.lift / lb.lift AS lift_change
FROM lift_after la
JOIN lift_before lb ON lb.vertex = la.vertex
JOIN fans f ON f.brand_id = la.vertex
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = la.vertex
WHERE la.vertex > 0 AND la.vertex <> 2595
  AND f.fans_before >= 1000 AND f.fans_after >= 1000
ORDER BY lift_change DESC, b.brand_name
LIMIT 25

steps.intent: Run it: which brands moved toward Barbie's audience after the July release?
steps.sql:
WITH likes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT -(e.user_id + 1) AS src, CAST(i.brand_id AS BIGINT) AS dst,
         e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00' AS after_release
  FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'item_like' AND i.brand_id <> 0
    AND e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-05-01 00:00:00'
    AND e.event_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00'
), lift_before AS (
  SELECT p.vertex, p.value / r.value AS lift
  FROM cugraph_personalized_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE NOT after_release),
    personalization => (SELECT 2595 AS vertex, 1.0 AS value),
    directed => false) p
  JOIN cugraph_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE NOT after_release), directed => false) r
    ON r.vertex = p.vertex
), lift_after AS (
  SELECT p.vertex, p.value / r.value AS lift
  FROM cugraph_personalized_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE after_release),
    personalization => (SELECT 2595 AS vertex, 1.0 AS value),
    directed => false) p
  JOIN cugraph_pagerank(
    edges => (SELECT src, dst FROM likes WHERE after_release), directed => false) r
    ON r.vertex = p.vertex
), fans AS (
  SELECT dst AS brand_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN after_release THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS fans_before,
         SUM(CASE WHEN after_release THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fans_after
  FROM likes GROUP BY dst
), brands AS (
  SELECT CAST(brand_id AS BIGINT) AS brand_id, MIN(brand_name) AS brand_name
  FROM merrec_items WHERE brand_id <> 0 GROUP BY brand_id
)
SELECT b.brand_name, f.fans_before, f.fans_after,
       lb.lift AS lift_before, la.lift AS lift_after, la.lift / lb.lift AS lift_change
FROM lift_after la
JOIN lift_before lb ON lb.vertex = la.vertex
JOIN fans f ON f.brand_id = la.vertex
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = la.vertex
WHERE la.vertex > 0 AND la.vertex <> 2595
  AND f.fans_before >= 1000 AND f.fans_after >= 1000
ORDER BY lift_change DESC, b.brand_name
LIMIT 25;

FROM cugraph_personalized_pagerank(
  edges => (SELECT DISTINCT -(e.user_id + 1) AS src, CAST(i.brand_id AS BIGINT) AS dst
            FROM merrec_events e JOIN merrec_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id
            WHERE e.event_type = 'item_like' AND i.brand_id <> 0
              AND e.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-07-01 00:00:00' AND e.event_time < TIMESTAMP '2023-09-01 00:00:00'),
  personalization => (SELECT 2595 AS brand_id, 1.0 AS weight),
